themes.note: Light values are canonical in the frontmatter. Dark values apply under prefers-color-scheme: dark (unless data-theme="light") and under data-theme="dark"; see colorMeta.<token>.dark. band-ink, band-muted, term-ink, term-dim, term-err and term-prompt do not change.
themes.trackScope: .t-sql | .t-bash | .t-docker | .t-fastapi | .t-spring set --trk and --trk-soft; components reference var(--trk) / var(--trk-soft), never a specific track.

headline.purpose: Page titles for modules and tool pages; 36px on phones.

title-pixel.purpose: Section headings and lesson h2s (28px), track panel names (40px), rail track title (34px).

title.purpose: Exercise titles (20px) and the Continue heading (clamp 22px to 30px, -0.015em).

label.purpose: Buttons (14.5px), level tags, rail labels, table headers; sentence case.

numeral.purpose: Solved counts, rail stats (18px), review scores (40px).

mono.purpose: Code, editors, terminal, and all index numbers.

shadows.name: current-indicator
shadows.purpose: Left bar on the current module in the rail. An indicator, not elevation; the system is otherwise flat.

motion.name: pixel-light
motion.value: lightup .36s steps(4, end) both (clip-path inset 100% top to 0)
motion.purpose: Fills a pixel or stepper cell bottom-to-top when its exercise is solved.

motion.name: control-state
motion.value: background-color .12s steps(2, end), border-color .12s steps(2, end)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one coloured control per view: Continue, Check, Run, Next.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-ico" viewBox="0 0 8 8" shape-rendering="crispEdges" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="0" width="2" height="1"/><rect x="4" y="1" width="2" height="1"/><rect x="5" y="2" width="2" height="1"/><rect x="0" y="3" width="7" height="2"/><rect x="5" y="5" width="2" height="1"/><rect x="4" y="6" width="2" height="1"/><rect x="3" y="7" width="2" height="1"/></svg>Continue</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b5bcc5); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1216); padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14.5px/1.3 var(--f-ui, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-direction: row-reverse; transition: background-color .12s steps(2, end), border-color .12s steps(2, end); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); color: var(--on-trk, #fff); border-color: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--trk, #0b7a6f) 86%, var(--ink, #0f1216)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--trk, #0b7a6f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ico { width: 1em; height: 1em; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Run beside Check, Previous/Next exercise, Reset.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b5bcc5); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1216); padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14.5px/1.3 var(--f-ui, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s steps(2, end), border-color .12s steps(2, end); } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #0f1216); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--trk, #0b7a6f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-default[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Tertiary links and the stuck-ladder (hints, expected output, solution).
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #545d68); padding: 8px 10px; font: 600 14.5px/1.3 var(--f-ui, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s steps(2, end); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: var(--ink, #0f1216); background: var(--surface-2, #e2e6ea); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--trk, #0b7a6f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pixel Strip
components.description: Signature progress map: one square per exercise, lit when solved, boss cells double width.
components.css: .ds-strip { --cell: 12px; --gap: 3px; display: flex; gap: var(--gap); } .ds-px { width: var(--cell); height: var(--cell); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b5bcc5); display: block; position: relative; } .ds-px.boss { width: calc(var(--cell) * 2 + var(--gap)); } .ds-px.on { background: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); border-color: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); } .ds-px.lit::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -1px; background: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); animation: ds-lightup .36s steps(4, end) both; } .ds-strip:hover .ds-px:not(.on) { border-color: var(--ink, #0f1216); } @keyframes ds-lightup { from { clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } }

components.name: Exercise Stepper
components.description: One square numbered button per exercise; solved cells fill, current cell gets an ink outline.
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-stepper button { height: 34px; min-width: 34px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b5bcc5); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--muted, #545d68); font: 600 14px var(--f-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stepper button.boss { min-width: 72px; } .ds-stepper button:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #0f1216); color: var(--ink, #0f1216); } .ds-stepper button.on { background: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); border-color: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); color: var(--on-trk, #fff); } .ds-stepper button[aria-current="true"] { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0f1216); outline-offset: 2px; color: var(--ink, #0f1216); } .ds-stepper button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--trk, #0b7a6f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3d8de); padding: 24px 26px 26px; display: grid; gap: 16px; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #0f1216); font-family: var(--f-ui, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-panel-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 500 40px/1 var(--f-pixel, "Pixelify Sans", Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-panel-top span { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted, #545d68); } .ds-panel-top b { font: 500 22px var(--f-pixel, "Pixelify Sans", sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #0f1216); } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #545d68); font-size: 15px; } .ds-panel-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted, #545d68); } .ds-panel-row > span:first-child { font: 12px var(--f-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); } .ds-cells { display: flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-cells i { width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b5bcc5); } .ds-cells i.on { background: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); border-color: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); }

components.name: Code Editor
components.description: Answer editor on code paper with track-hue caret and inset focus outline.
components.css: .ds-editor { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 72px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b5bcc5); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--code-bg, #f5f7f9); color: var(--ink, #0f1216); font: 14px/1.6 var(--f-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); caret-color: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); resize: vertical; } .ds-editor:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--trk, #0b7a6f); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Band
components.description: Ink top band: pixel brand mark, wordmark, track tabs with own-hue current bar.

components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: stretch; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--band, #0f1216); color: var(--band-ink, #f1f3f5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--band-line, #262b31); } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; font: 500 24px var(--f-pixel, "Pixelify Sans", sans-serif); padding-right: 22px; margin-right: 6px; border-right: 1px solid var(--band-line, #262b31); } .ds-band a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--band-muted, #a3acb6); text-decoration: none; font: 600 14.5px var(--f-ui, Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-band a i { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--c); } .ds-band a:hover, .ds-band a[aria-current="true"] { color: var(--band-ink, #f1f3f5); } .ds-band a[aria-current="true"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 0; height: 4px; background: var(--c); } .ds-band a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-steps { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #0f1216); background: var(--ground, #eceff2); } .ds-steps a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 18px 12px 0; margin-right: 18px; color: var(--muted, #545d68); text-decoration: none; font: 600 15px var(--f-ui, Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-steps a span { font: 13px var(--f-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); } .ds-steps a:hover, .ds-steps a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #0f1216); } .ds-steps a[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 4px; background: var(--trk, #0b7a6f); } .ds-steps a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--trk, #0b7a6f); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Swiss Design grid discipline fused with Pixel Art. The progress you have made is the map: every exercise is one square pixel, a module is a row of pixels, a track is a grid of rows. The pixels are not ornament; they are the record of what you solved, and they double as the navigation to what you have not. Around them sits a strict, flush-left Swiss page: square corners, 1px hairlines, large jumps between a pixel display face and a quiet grotesque.

The world is cool and nearly colourless at rest. An ink-black band sits over a light-grey ground (near-black in dark mode), panels are white sheets on that ground, and the only saturated colour is the current track's hue, which is spent exclusively on things you can act on and on pixels you have lit. Density is that of a working tool: comfortable reading measure for lessons, compact tabular rows for indexes, one exercise on screen at a time.

Motion is stepped. Solving an exercise fills its pixel bottom-to-top in four discrete frames; drawers and button states also move in steps, never on smooth curves.
keyCharacteristics: One pixel per exercise; boss exercises are double-width cells, so size carries hierarchy.
Five track hues (SQL teal, Bash orange, Docker blue, FastAPI violet, Spring green), one per surface, scoped by a track class.
Square corners everywhere; hairline borders; no drop shadows.
Pixelify Sans for display and big numerals, Geist for UI and reading, Geist Mono for code and indices.
All motion uses `steps()` timing; reduced-motion removes it entirely.
Full light and dark themes from the same token names (system preference, overridable by `data-theme`).

rules.name: The Lit Pixel Rule
rules.body: Track hue appears only on what you can act on (primary buttons, focus, link underlines, the active tab bar) and on pixels you have lit. Headings, panels, borders and body text stay ink and grey. If something is coloured and you cannot click it or did not earn it, it is wrong.

rules.name: The One Track Rule
rules.body: A surface takes its hue from the track scope it sits in. One panel, one hue; the home grid gives each track panel its own scope rather than mixing hues inside a panel.

rules.name: The Pixel Voice Rule
rules.body: Pixelify Sans is for display headings and big numerals only. Body, buttons, labels and form controls are Geist; never set running text or a control in the pixel face.

rules.name: The Mono Index Rule
rules.body: Ordinals and indices are Geist Mono with tabular figures, so columns of numbers line up like a register.

rules.name: The Visible Armature Rule
rules.body: The grid is drawn, not implied: track panels and the pager sit in a 1px-gutter grid whose gutters show the hairline colour, sections open on a full-width ink rule, and the step bar is underlined in ink.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. No drop shadows, blurs or glows; hierarchy is carried by tone, line weight and size.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is zero, everywhere. The pixel is the only shape.

rules.name: The Double Square Rule
rules.body: A boss exercise occupies two cells plus the gap. Importance is expressed by size, never by a different colour.

dos: **Do** spend track hue only on primary buttons, lit pixels, solved stepper cells, active tab bars, focus outlines, link underlines and the caret (The Lit Pixel Rule).
**Do** scope every track surface with its track class so one hue governs the whole panel or page.
**Do** keep every corner at 0px and every structural border at 1px.
**Do** express importance by size: boss exercises take a double cell, display type jumps straight from 84px to body.
**Do** time every transition and animation with `steps()`: 4 steps over 360ms for lighting a pixel, 4 steps over 240ms for the drawer, 2 steps over 120ms for button states.
**Do** draw icons on the 8 by 8 pixel grid as crisp-edged SVG rectangles in the current text colour.
**Do** set indices and code in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
**Do** define every colour for both themes through the shared token names.
donts: **Don't** colour headings, panel backgrounds, borders or decorative marks with a track hue.
**Don't** add drop shadows, blurs, glows or rounded corners.
**Don't** use smooth easing curves for motion.
**Don't** set body copy, buttons, labels or inputs in Pixelify Sans.
**Don't** mix two track hues inside one panel.
**Don't** use emoji or font glyphs as icons.
